title: Roaya claim/evidence registry
description: Documented schema for scripts/claim-evidence/registry.json (TIFO-16). This file is the human-readable contract; scripts/claim-evidence/validate-registry.mjs implements the equivalent checks in plain Node (no schema-validation library is a project dependency, so the enforcement is hand-written but must stay in lockstep with this document).

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must be unique across the whole registry.

topic.description: Optional narrow-scope classifier. Currently only 'uptime' is defined, because uptime is the one approved fact family that is scope-limited (CloudEdge/Posta only) rather than blanket-approved.

scope.description: For topic 'uptime': the products the claim is allowed to apply to. A verified uptime claim's scope must be a non-empty subset of ['cloudedge','posta']. Null for claims with no topic.

sourcePointer.description: Relative in-repo file path (optionally with a '#fragment' locator), e.g. 'src/assets/i18n/en.json#about.story.p1'. Must not be an absolute path, must not contain '..', must not be a bare URL. Required (non-null) whenever status is 'verified'.

decisionReference.description: Human-readable pointer to the approving decision (e.g. a Stage 0 decision label). Required (non-null, non-empty) whenever status is 'verified'.

reviewDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) this entry was last reviewed, or null if never reviewed.

slug.description: Case-study only: must match a slug in src/app/features/resources/case-studies/case-studies.data.ts.

clientApprovalReference.description: Case-study only: written client-approval reference/date. Must stay null until a real approval is attached.

metricEvidencePointer.description: Case-study only: pointer to the metric evidence backing the case study's published numbers. Must stay null until real evidence is attached.
